name: mirage
text: Version 1.0.75 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.75 . It saves your full Diagnostics report to GitHub every 20 minutes. Version 1.0.76, which clears the phone's logs after each successful save, is building and I'll send its link. Install 1.0.75 or wait for 1.0.76, then leave the +EV tab running for about 20 minutes. After that I read your report from GitHub.
